commands_used: answer 1. I am hunting the seven marked towers for myself, not the order. A wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, an Archwarden fort. Never-Writes-Twice dismissed it, which seems suspicious. 2. Get into the fort keep and see its cellar, starting here at the fort gate. 3. Ask the wall captain Sakeeus-Wan for leave to enter, or find another way in unseen, such as the guardroom door. The keep door is locked. 4. I do not know what moans in the cellar, or who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is exactly. I could find out by asking people here and seeing the cellar.

answer 1. I want to see the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth for my own hunt. The captain Sakeeus-Wan will open the keep and pay 100 gold if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing carts on the western approach. 2. Go to the western approach, kill the three raiders, then report to Sakeeus-Wan. 3. Fight the raiders for the captain (the captain route), or sneak in by a trapdoor in the yard unseen. 4. I do not know what is in the cellar, or what the old prison below the keep holds; the captain said it is the order is, not his. I would find out by getting in.

answer 1. I killed the raiders and got the keep key and 100 gold. The cellar stair starts in the quartermaster store inside the keep; quartermaster Theyne Indarys holds that key. 2. Go into the keep, reach the store, go down the stair, speak to the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku and try the cellar door. 3. Pick the store lock, lift the quartermasters key, or ask him; the captain warned I would be a thief in the store. 4. I do not understand what a Jar of Hist Sap (Jal-Veesa Knot) is or what moans in the cellar; I would find out by looking.
